caption_L1: This line plot is called Cote d'Ivoire : Birth rate from 2008 to 2018 (per 1,000 inhabitants). The x-axis shows Year while the y-axis plots Birth rate per thousand population.
caption_L2L3: The birth rate in Cote d'Ivoire has been steadily declining between 2008 and 2018. The rate in 2008 was approximately 38 per 1000 inhabitants, but 10 years later this had fallen to around 36 per 1000.  The rate of decline has been steady, with no years where the rate of decline slowed or accelerated.
